scope: Active website and isolated CMS moved completely from Next compiler/server commands to Vinext; hosting retained. Archived Next applications remain retired.

website.production: Nitro Bun server or Vercel prebuilt Bun function
website.nextDependency: Development types and Payload peer compatibility only; no active Next compiler/server commands

cmsInstance.migration: Separate bundled migration with directly declared @vercel/nft traced closure

applications.console: Existing Vite application, aligned React version and requalified

compatibilityFixes: Payload RSC/client boundaries stay in Vite while native Payload/database packages stay external
CJS client dependencies are prebundled for development
Public srvx request adaptation preserves JSON POST/PUT/PATCH bodies, methods and auth headers under Bun
Pinned Vinext patch handles versioned Google-font module IDs and emits OG WASM in Nitro output
Owned OG logo/font assets are embedded at build time; local avatar avoids third-party requests
Managed CMS export, Docker startup, migration closure, artifact ignores and qualification harness use Vinext outputs

websiteRuntimeProof: Fresh isolated PostgreSQL with distinct migration/runtime roles
Public routes, SEO, self-hosted fonts, responsive hydration
PNG OG signature and exact 1200x630 dimensions
OIDC discovery, PKCE, nonce and signed ID token against a local IdP
Payload field-permissions API, edit/save, SQL readback and public content update
Live role downgrade, mutation denial and session revocation
qualification.developmentFixtureTransport: Explicit non-production HTTP loopback SSO; exact copied app source protects generated types
qualification.productionIntentPrefetch: Exact source with real Vinext RSC hover/focus prefetch and client navigation
qualification.cmsImageProof: Source and separately exported images passed fresh PG18/TLS, separate roles, explicit/idempotent migrations, legacy retained media, exact 10 MiB bridge transport and container recreation

limitations: Controlled local IdP/database fixtures, not real customer/provider or full-platform E2E acceptance
Vinext CI qualification, main merge and production candidate/promotion are separate remaining release gates
Managed CMS production rollout requires matching Core/artifact/environment qualification; no partial backend rollout
Complete internal rebrand still has versioned data/auth/protocol and operational migrations beyond this framework change
